responsibility: This file is the DFA-based pipeline model for the RM7000 processor. It describes the dual-issue bundling rules, M-pipe and F-pipe execution resources, isolated long-latency integer and FP divide automata, and the reservations for integer, memory, branch, coprocessor-transfer, multiply/divide, and floating-point instructions, giving GCC a detailed scheduler model for r7000-specific issue restrictions and latencies.
